title: Cartwise Rewards Birthday, Anniversary and Referral Benefits by Tier
content:
Birthday points, enrollment-anniversary points and referral points are the Cartwise Rewards benefits that do not come from the member's own order spend. Their amounts by tier are:

| Tier | Birthday bonus (points) | Enrollment anniversary bonus (points) | Referral bonus (points) | Referral bonuses per calendar year, at most | Referred friend's first-order item subtotal needed, at least |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 0 | 0 | 500 | 5 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 100 | 0 | 500 | 5 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 200 | 100 | 750 | 10 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 300 | 200 | 750 | 10 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 500 | 300 | 1000 | 15 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 1000 | 500 | 1000 | 20 | $35.00 |

## When each benefit is dated

| Benefit | Date it counts from, at every tier |
|---|---|
| Birthday bonus | Posts in the customer's birth month |
| Enrollment anniversary bonus | Counted from the date the customer enrolled in Cartwise Rewards |
| Referral bonus | The referred friend's first completed order |

## Reading the table

- A 0 in a column means the tier offers none of that benefit: Cartwise Rewards Member has no birthday bonus, and Cartwise Rewards Member and Cartwise Rewards Bronze have no enrollment anniversary bonus.
- Every tier, Member included, has a referral bonus; the amount and the yearly count differ by tier, while the $35.00 first-order item subtotal is the same at every tier.
- The yearly count of referral bonuses runs by calendar year.

## Hypothetical comparisons

- A hypothetical Cartwise Rewards Gold member's birthday bonus is 300 points and anniversary bonus is 200 points; the same member at Cartwise Rewards Diamond would have 1000 and 500.
- A referred friend's first completed order with a hypothetical item subtotal of $35.00 meets the referral threshold at every tier; one of $34.99 meets it at none.
- A hypothetical Cartwise Rewards Silver member who has already received 10 referral bonuses in the current calendar year has reached that tier's yearly count; a Platinum member at 10 has not reached the Platinum count of 15.
